title: Deploy, in the order the scripts enforce

steps.title: Pull and check the fleet is idle
steps.note: git pull --ff-only on the PC, then a guard refuses to continue while a team is running. Drop --simulation to do it for real.

steps.title: Raspberry Pi: control plane and web UI
steps.note: rsync harness/ to /home/pi/ccremote-harness, scp pi-web/ to /home/pi/ccremote-web, install both systemd units.

steps.title: PC: restart the supervisor
steps.note: No copy: the user unit ccremote-pc runs the repo in place. The script checks the process is newer than the sources.

steps.title: VPS: fallback supervisor
steps.note: rsync to /home/ubuntu/ccremote/harness, bun install, ~/.config/ccremote/pc.env, user unit ccremote-pc. Without --demarrer nothing starts.
